instruction: Set up an AWS builder in a Packer template
output: echo 'source "amazon-ebs" "ubuntu" { ami_name = "ubuntu-22.04-{{timestamp}}" instance_type = "t3.micro" region = "us-east-1" source_ami_filter { filters = { name = "ubuntu/images/hvm-ssd/ubuntu-jammy-22.04-amd64-server-*" } owners = ["099720109477"] most_recent = true } ssh_username = "ubuntu" }' > sources.pkr.hcl

instruction: Add a shell provisioner that updates packages
output: echo 'build { sources = ["source.amazon-ebs.ubuntu"] provisioner "shell" { inline = ["sudo apt update", "sudo apt upgrade -y"] } }' > build.pkr.hcl

instruction: Validate a variable with custom condition
